title.en: Europe heatwave live: red warning issued for millions in England; France and Belgium cancel events
title.zh: 英格兰东南部发布红色高温预警；今日1.5亿欧洲人将经历35摄氏度以上高温——欧洲热浪实时报道

summary.en: South-east England is under a red heat warning for a third consecutive day, with 150 million Europeans expected to experience temperatures above 35C. Scientists state this is Europe's worst-ever heatwave and impossible without the climate crisis, leading to public alcohol bans in Paris and strain on hospitals.
summary.zh: 英国东南部连续第三天发布红色高温预警，预计今天将有1.5亿欧洲人经历35摄氏度以上的高温。科学家表示，这是欧洲有史以来最严重的热浪，若无气候危机则不可能发生，导致巴黎禁止公共饮酒，医院也面临压力。

body.en: Estimated 150 million people in Europe could experience temperatures above 35C today European heatwave is worst ever and impossible without climate crisis, scientists say Over in the UK, firefighters are still trying to bring a large wildfire in Derbyshire under control. The blaze, which has burned over 500 square metres of moorland and woodland on Tintwistle Moor, near Glossop, broke out on Wednesday evening, with fire crews from Manchester and Derbyshire deploying a water-dropping helicopter and six fire engines on Thursday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于巴黎骄傲游行推迟，巴黎将禁止在公共场所饮酒；英国首次连续三天发布红色预警 欧洲热浪是有史以来最严重的，如果没有气候危机，科学家称巴黎将禁止在公共场所饮酒，因为医院达到热浪临界点 在英国，消防队员仍在努力控制德比郡的大火。大火于周三晚间爆发，已烧毁格洛索普附近廷特维斯尔沼泽 (Tinttwistle Moor) 500 多平方米的沼泽地和林地，来自曼彻斯特和德比郡的消防人员于周四部署了一架洒水直升机和六辆消防车。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The intense heatwave across Europe, with its severe impact on daily life and public health, reminds us of the profound interconnectedness between humanity and the natural world. As creation groans under the weight of environmental shifts, we are called to reflect on our role in stewarding the Earth and caring for one another amidst these challenges....
reflection.zh: 欧洲各地的高温热浪，对日常生活和公共健康造成了严重影响，这提醒我们人类与自然世界之间深刻的相互关联。当受造之物在环境变化的重压下发出叹息时，我们被呼召反思自己在管理地球和在这些挑战中彼此关怀的角色。雅伟的创造虽然有韧性，但也经历着痛苦，促使我们在应对时寻求智慧和怜悯。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Venezuela earthquakes: 589 confirmed dead so far as international rescue teams arrive – latest updates
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震：国际救援队抵达，已确认235人死亡——最新进展

summary.en: International rescue teams have arrived in Venezuela following a series of earthquakes, with 235 deaths confirmed so far. Authorities fear the final death toll could reach into the thousands, as rescue efforts continue.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉发生一系列地震后，国际救援队已抵达该国，目前已确认235人死亡。当局担心最终死亡人数可能达到数千人，救援工作仍在进行中。

body.en: ‘We hope to rescue as many living people as possible’, says the acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, but authorities fear the death toll will be in the thousands China’s president Xi Jinping said Beijing was ready to provide Venezuela with “disaster relief and reconstruction” assistance. Xi sent a message of condolence to Venezuela’s interim president Delcy Rodríguez today, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据委内瑞拉国家电视台 VTV 报道，今天上午，一支由 80 名瑞士救援人员组成的救援队抵达委内瑞拉。 瑞士代表团包括搜救专家以及 18 吨物资和八只搜救犬。 土耳其宣布，两架飞机将于今天离开伊斯坦布尔，载有军事、医疗和救援人员以及一对搜救犬，而荷兰也表示将派遣一支由 65 名救援人员、搜救犬和设备组成的团队。

reflection.en: In the wake of such devastating loss, our hearts ache for those who have died and those who mourn. This verse reminds us of Yahweh's ultimate promise to wipe away every tear, bringing an end to death, sorrow, and pain. It offers a profound hope that beyond this present suffering, a time will come when such tragedies are no more.
reflection.zh: 面对如此毁灭性的损失，我们的心为逝者和哀悼者感到悲痛。这节经文提醒我们雅伟最终的应许，祂将擦去一切眼泪，使死亡、悲伤和痛苦不再存在。它提供了一个深刻的盼望，即超越眼前的苦难，一个不再有此类悲剧的时代终将到来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: State functions, public access and office space: the plans for revamped Buckingham Palace
title.zh: 国家职能、公众开放和办公空间：白金汉宫改造计划

summary.en: King Charles has decided not to reside in Buckingham Palace, despite a £369 million renovation. Aides confirm the landmark will instead serve as a vibrant center for royal activities, focusing on state functions, public access, and office space.
summary.zh: 查尔斯国王决定不居住在白金汉宫，尽管该宫殿正在进行耗资3.69亿英镑的翻修。助手们证实，这座地标性建筑将成为皇家活动的活跃中心，主要用于国家职能、公众开放和办公空间。

body.en: King Charles will never live in landmark despite £369m upgrade, but aides stress it will remain ‘buzzing hive’ of royal activity Not all modern British monarchs have viewed the prospect of moving into Buckingham Palace with unalloyed joy. So in announcing he will never live there, after the completion of its £369m upgrade next year, King Charles has at least grasped that nettle. Queen Victoria was initially dismayed by the damp, dingy and disorganised building that greeted her and her husband, Prince Albert, in 1837. It was Albert who refashioned it into “Monarchy HQ”. After his death in 1861, Victoria retreated mainly to Windsor, Balmoral and Osborne House on the Isle of Wight. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管耗资 3.69 亿英镑进行了升级，查尔斯国王永远不会住在这座地标性建筑中，但助手们强调，这里仍将是王室活动的“热闹蜂巢”。 并非所有现代英国君主都对搬进白金汉宫的前景充满纯粹的喜悦。因此，在明年完成耗资 3.69 亿英镑的升级改造后，查尔斯国王宣布他永远不会住在那里，至少已经抓住了这个难题。维多利亚女王最初对 1837 年迎接她和她的丈夫阿尔伯特亲王的这座潮湿、肮脏、杂乱的建筑感到沮丧。阿尔伯特将其改造成“君主制总部”。 1861 年去世后，维多利亚主要撤退到温莎、巴尔莫勒尔堡和怀特岛的奥斯本宫。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision to transform Buckingham Palace into a hub for state functions and public access, rather than a private residence, highlights the evolving nature of public service. It reminds us that those in positions of authority are called to administer justice and righteousness, ensuring their institutions serve the common good. Yahweh calls leaders to...
reflection.zh: 将白金汉宫改造为国家职能和公众开放的中心，而非私人住所，突显了公共服务不断演变的本质。这提醒我们，身居高位者蒙召要施行公义和正直，确保其机构服务于共同利益。雅伟呼召领袖优先考虑其人民的福祉，这反映了对职责而非个人舒适的承诺。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Ex-Trump adviser John Bolton expected to plead guilty in classified information case – US politics live
title.zh: 前特朗普顾问约翰·博尔顿预计将在机密信息案中认罪——美国政治直播

summary.en: Former Trump adviser John Bolton is expected to plead guilty to charges of unlawfully retaining sensitive national security information. The agreement includes a $2.25 million fine.
summary.zh: 前特朗普顾问约翰·博尔顿预计将承认非法保留敏感国家安全信息的指控。该协议包括225万美元的罚款。

body.en: Bolton to plead guilty charges that he unlawfully retained sensitive national security information in agreement that includes $2.25m fine Sign up for the Breaking News US email The decades-long prison sentences for a group of Texas activists convicted of terrorism and other charges in connection to a Fourth of July protest last year has caused widespread alarm, given their unusually punitive length and for the apparent harsh criminalization of protest activity under Donald Trump ’s justice department. Eight people who participated in a protest at the Prairieland ICE detention facility in Alvarado, Texas, were sentenced on Tuesday to between 50 and 100 years in prison . A ninth person, Daniel Sanchez-Estrada, the husband of one of the demonstrators, did not participate in the protest, but was sentenced to 30 years in prison after he was convicted of moving boxes containing leftwing zines and other materials after a prison phone call from his wife. [The zines Sanchez-Estrada was punished for moving are] no different from the pro-Revolution pamphlets this country’s founders had in mind when they drafted the first amendment’s press clause. Sanchez’s case is the latest example of the Trump administration grasping at any legal straws it can to criminalize disfavored ideologies and writings , from conflating dissent with terrorism to deporting immigrants who report on protests or criticize wars the US bankrolls. Continue reading...
body.zh: 博尔顿承认在协议中非法保留敏感国家安全信息的指控，其中包括 225 万美元的罚款。去年 7 月 4 日抗议活动中，一群因恐怖主义和其他指控而被定罪的得克萨斯州活动人士被判处数十年监禁，这引起了广泛的恐慌，因为这些活动的惩罚时间异常长，而且唐纳德·特朗普司法部门对抗议活动明显严厉定罪。参加德克萨斯州阿尔瓦拉多 Prairieland ICE 拘留所抗议活动的 8 人于周二被判处 50 至 100 年监禁。第九个人，丹尼尔·桑切斯-埃斯特拉达（Daniel Sanchez-Estrada）是其中一名示威者的丈夫，他没有参加抗议活动，但在接到妻子的监狱电话后，因搬运装有左翼杂志和其他材料的箱子而被判入狱 30 年。 [桑切斯-埃斯特拉达因搬迁而受到惩罚的杂志]与这个国家的创始人在起草第一修正案的新闻条款时所想到的支持革命的小册子没有什么不同。桑切斯案是特朗普政府利用一切法律手段将不受欢迎的意识形态和著作定为犯罪的最新例子，从将异议与恐怖主义混为一谈，到驱逐报道抗议活动或批评美国资助的战争的移民。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news reminds us of the profound trust placed in public servants, especially concerning national security. Yahweh's word teaches that faithfulness in handling even seemingly small responsibilities reflects a deeper integrity. May all who serve in positions of trust be diligent and upright in their stewardship.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，公众仆人，尤其是在国家安全领域，肩负着深厚的信任。雅伟的话语教导我们，在处理看似微小的责任上忠心，反映出更深层的正直。愿所有身居要职的人都能勤勉正直地履行他们的职责。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Kent van driver praised for giving lift to armed officer chasing suspect
title.zh: 肯特郡货车司机因帮助追捕嫌犯的武装警官而受表扬

summary.en: A van driver in Kent has been praised for assisting an armed police officer who was chasing a suspect. Bodycam footage captured the moment the motorist pulled over and offered the officer a lift.
summary.zh: 肯特郡一名货车司机因帮助一名正在追捕嫌犯的武装警官而受到表扬。警官的随身摄像机拍下了这名司机停车并让警官上车的瞬间。

body.en:
A van driver in Kent has been praised after giving a lift to an armed police officer who was chasing a suspect.

Bodycam footage from the officer captured the moment the motorist pulled over to help the police on 16 June and called out: “Get in the back. Get in the back.”

The officer got in the van and said, with the sliding door still open: “Go, go, go! Cheers buddy. Follow that police officer.” As the driver sped off in the direction of the suspect, the officer continued: “Just go past him. Keep going past him.”

The motorist driving at fast speeds is cautioned by the officer: “Don’t crash,” to which the motorist replies: “I won’t crash, sir.”

According to Kent police, the officer, carrying a large weapon, was pursuing a “violent offender” who had fled a property in Margate after an alleged serious assault and ran into a park to evade capture. It is believed the suspect was “close to losing patrols” until the “responsible and public-spirited driver” decided to step in to help.

The footage shows the driver pulling up at the side of the road after overtaking the suspect, where the officer jumps out and says: “Don’t move. Put your hands on your head.” The suspect was then arrested.

A later clip shows the officer shaking the driver’s hand and thanking him for his help, to which the motorist replied: “I am just glad I could be of service. That was quite exhilarating.”

Armed policing supt Will Lay said: “A violent offender who was being relentlessly pursued, and was seeking to evade capture, came close to losing patrols in a nearby park. However, our armed officers remained committed.

“Thanks to the quick and selfless actions of this responsible and public-spirited driver, officers were able to apprehend the dangerous individual,” he added.

“The successful arrest may not have been possible without the member of the public and his vehicle. He should feel proud of his contribution to keeping his community safe and we are truly grateful for his assistance.”
body.zh: 肯特郡的一名面包车司机在载送一名正在追捕嫌疑人的武装警察后受到赞扬。 6 月 16 日，这名警官的随身摄像机捕捉到了这名驾车者靠边停车帮助警察的那一刻，并大喊：“到后面去。到后面去。” 警察上了车，拉门还开着，说道：“走，走，走！干杯，伙计。跟着那个警察。”当司机朝嫌疑人的方向疾驰时，警官继续说道：“就从他身边过去。继续从他身边过去。” 警察警告高速行驶的司机：“不要撞车”，司机回答：“我不会撞车，先生。” 据肯特郡警方称，这名警官携带大型武器，正在追捕一名“暴力罪犯”，这名“暴力罪犯”在涉嫌严重袭击后逃离马盖特的一处房产，并跑进公园躲避抓捕。据信，嫌疑人“差点失去巡逻队”，直到“负责任且热心公益的司机”决定介入提供帮助。 视频显示，司机超越嫌疑人后将车停在路边，警察跳下车说：“别动。把手放在头上。”嫌疑人随后被捕。 后来的一段视频显示，警官与司机握手，感谢他的帮助，司机回答道：“我很高兴能为您服务。这真是令人兴奋。” 武装警务督察威尔·莱 (Will Lay) 表示：“一名暴力犯罪分子遭到无情追捕，并试图逃避抓捕，差点失去附近公园的巡逻人员。不过，我们的武装警察仍然恪尽职守。” 他补充说：“由于这位负责任且热心公益的司机迅速而无私的行动，警方得以逮捕了这名危险人物。” “如果没有公众及其车辆，成功的逮捕可能是不可能的。他应该为自己为维护社区安全所做的贡献感到自豪，我们衷心感谢他的帮助。”

reflection.en: This story reminds us of the power of spontaneous kindness and civic cooperation. Like the Good Samaritan, the driver saw a need and acted, offering practical help to someone in pursuit of justice. Such acts of neighborly care strengthen our communities and reflect a spirit of selfless service.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们自发善意和公民合作的力量。就像好撒玛利亚人一样，这位司机看到了需要并采取了行动，为一位正在追捕嫌犯的警官提供了实际帮助。这种邻里关怀的行为能增强我们的社区，并反映出一种无私服务的精神。

verse.textEn: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers? ... 'Go and do likewise.'
verse.textZh: 你想这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？……「你去照样行吧。」

title.en: Bayer: Why so many Roundup weedkiller lawsuits?
title.zh: 拜耳：为何农达除草剂诉讼缠身？

summary.en: Bayer faces numerous lawsuits for allegedly failing to include cancer warnings on its Roundup weedkiller, despite US regulators opposing such a warning. The article questions whether a recent Supreme Court decision will protect the chemical giant from paying billions in damages.
summary.zh: 拜耳公司因被指控未能在其备受争议的农达除草剂上添加癌症警告而面临多起诉讼，尽管美国监管机构反对添加此类警告。德国之声质疑，最近的最高法院裁决是否能阻止这家化工巨头支付数十亿美元的赔偿金。

body.en:
Bayer was sued for failing to add cancer warnings to its controversial pesticide Roundup, when US regulators opposed adding one. DW asks if the latest Supreme Court win will stop the chemical giant from paying billions.

Bayer is still grappling with tens of thousands of lawsuits over its glyphosate -based weedkiller Roundup, which plaintiffs claim causes cancer , primarily non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

Germany's agrochemicals giant inherited the legal mess after taking over Monsanto, the company that produced Roundup, in 2018.

Farmers, landscapers and gardeners — mostly based in the United States — argue that Monsanto knew, or should have known, about the risks but failed to provide adequate warnings on product labels.

According to the Lawsuit Information Center, Bayer has so far paid out around $11 billion (€9.65 billion) to settle roughly 100,000 cases. Around 61,000 to 65,000 claims remain active.

The company has cited decades of scientific studies and regulatory research showing that glyphosate is safe and does not cause cancer.

Bayer, which is among the top firms listed on the Frankfurt stock exchange, has won several legal cases, but it has also been hit with several high‑profile losses.

On Thursday, the top US court delivered a major victory to Bayer , ruling that claimants cannot sue the company in state courts over the lack of cancer warnings on the weedkiller.

The justices decided 7-2 that, as US federal regulators do not require a warning on products containing glyphosate, individual states cannot force companies to add one.

The case centered on a gardener, John Durnell from St Louis, Missouri, who won $1.25 million in compensation after blaming Roundup for his cancer.

The Supreme Court, however, ruled Thursday that Federal law, which governs pesticides, takes priority.

Durnell’s lawsuit became the key test case for thousands of other claims in state courts, even though the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had signed off on Roundup's labels.

In 2019, the EPA wrote to glyphosate producers telling them that adding a cancer warning would be "false and misleading."

This effectively barred Bayer from adding the warning, even when required to by state regulators.

The company, which is headquartered in Leverkusen, western Germany, argued it should not be punished for following federal rules.

In a statement after the Supreme Court ruling, Bayer said that glyphosate remains the "most studied crop protection tool in the world," adding that the decision "affirms that the EPA’s safety determination is the law of the land."

body.zh: 拜耳因未能在其备受争议的农药农达中添加癌症警告而被起诉，而美国监管机构反对添加这一警告。德国之声询问最高法院最新的胜诉是否会阻止这家化学巨头支付数十亿美元。 拜耳仍在努力应对数万起有关其基于草甘膦的除草剂农达的诉讼，原告声称该产品会导致癌症，主要是非霍奇金淋巴瘤。 德国农化巨头在 2018 年收购了生产农达的孟山都公司后，接手了法律上的混乱局面。 农民、园林设计师和园丁（主要来自美国）认为孟山都公司知道或应该知道这些风险，但未能在产品标签上提供足够的警告。 据诉讼信息中心称，拜耳迄今已支付约 110 亿美元（96.5 亿欧元）来解决约 10 万起案件。大约 61,000 至 65,000 份索赔仍然有效。 该公司引用了数十年的科学研究和监管研究表明草甘膦是安全的并且不会致癌。 拜耳是法兰克福证券交易所顶级上市公司之一，已赢得多起法律诉讼，但也遭受了多起引人注目的损失。 周四，美国最高法院为拜耳带来了重大胜利，裁定原告不能因该除草剂缺乏癌症警告而在州法院起诉该公司。 法官以 7-2 的方式裁定，由于美国联邦监管机构不要求对含有草甘膦的产品发出警告，因此各个州不能强迫公司添加警告。 此案以来自密苏里州圣路易斯的园丁 John Durnell 为中心，他在将癌症归咎于农达后获得了 125 万美元的赔偿。 然而，最高法院周四裁定，管理农药的联邦法律优先。 尽管美国环境保护署 (EPA) 已经批准了农达的标签，但德内尔的诉讼成为州法院数千起其他索赔的关键测试案例。 2019 年，美国环保局写信给草甘膦生产商，告诉他们添加癌症警告将是“虚假和误导性的”。 这实际上阻止了拜耳添加警告，即使州监管机构要求这样做。 该公司总部位于德国西部勒沃库森，辩称它不应因遵守联邦规则而受到惩罚。 在最高法院裁决后的一份声明中，拜耳表示，草甘膦仍然是“世界上研究最多的作物保护工具”，并补充说，该裁决“确认了美国环保局的安全决定是国家法律”。 不。这项最新裁决仅删除了针对拜耳的一项关键索赔，特别是未能遵守州法律并增加了癌症......

Yahweh delights in integrity, and this story reminds us that businesses bear a profound responsibility to provide accurate information about their products, especially concerning public health.

title.en: Balochistan activist's life sentence raises fear of unrest
title.zh: 俾路支省活动人士被判无期徒刑引发对骚乱的担忧

summary.en: With the conviction of a leading rights campaigner, Pakistan has drawn criticism from rights groups and sparked fears it could deepen unrest in Balochistan and weaken trust in peaceful activism.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
With the conviction of a leading rights campaigner, Pakistan has drawn criticism from rights groups and sparked fears it could deepen unrest in Balochistan and weaken trust in peaceful activism.

A Pakistani  anti-terrorism court this week sentenced two civil rights activists to life imprisonment over the killing of a paramilitary soldier during a July 2024 protest.

Mahrang Baloch, 33, is a prominent campaigner against alleged enforced disappearances in Balochistan and leader of the Balochistan Unity Committee (BYC). On June 25, she was convicted of murder and terrorism alongside fellow activist Sibghatullah Shahji. Both activists boycotted the trial and have denied the charges against them.

Baloch's lawyer, Israr Jattak, said the activists would appeal the verdict. Jattak recently met with the pair and reported that they were in good mental and physical health.

"The court is using the law as a weapon against us. The court and the judicial system exposed themselves through this judgment," Baloch told DW via her lawyer. 

The verdict drew sharp criticism from rights organizations . The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan called for a review of the ruling, saying the state had "continued its policy of treating fundamental rights advocacy in the same way it treats extremism, resulting in administrative and judicial decisions that are one-sided and biased."

Shahid Rind, a spokesperson for the Balochistan government, told DW that the prosecution was conducted fairly, insisting the case was backed by "undeniable evidence" and was not politically motivated.

Baloch and Shahji were arrested in March 2025 and are being held at Hudda District Prison in Balochistan's capital, Quetta.

According to the prosecution, Baloch did not physically kill the paramilitary soldier herself. Instead, prosecutors alleged that she incited and led a crowd during a July 2024 protest in Gwadar, and that the crowd attacked security personnel.

They said a paramilitary soldier, Sepoy Shabbir Ahmed, became separated from his colleagues and was beaten to death by protesters.

"These allegations are being used to create an atmosphere where political dissent is branded as a crime and demands for human rights are labelled as enmity against the state," said Baloch in a statement issued form the jail and posted on BYC's official social media accounts earlier this month.

Mahrang Baloch is a medical doctor-turned-human rights activist and a leading figure in the Baloch Yakjehti Committee (BYC), a human rights movement based in Balochistan. 

Her activism began after her father, Abdul Ghaffar Langove, was allegedly forcibly disappeared in 2009. His body was later recovered in 2011.

title.en: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
title.zh: 联合国在货船遇袭后暂停霍尔木兹海峡撤离计划

summary.en: An evacuation plan by the United Nations in the Strait of Hormuz has been halted following an attack on a cargo ship near Oman. Reports indicate the vessel was hit by an "unknown projectile," though no casualties were reported.
summary.zh: 联合国暂停了霍尔木兹海峡的撤离计划，此前一艘货船在阿曼附近遭到袭击。据报道，该船被一枚“不明弹丸”击中，但没有人员伤亡报告。

body.en:
The UN's International Maritime Organization (IMO) has paused the planned evacuation of more than 11,000 sailors stranded in the Strait of Hormuz after a cargo ship passing through the waterway was attacked.

IMO chief Arsenio Dominguez said several boats had already been evacuated, but the agency wanted to ensure that "necessary safety guarantees" would continue to be in place.

The British maritime security agency UKMTO reported on Thursday that a ship had been struck 7.5 nautical miles southeast of Oman's port of Dahit by "an unknown projectile". No casualties were reported.

The ship's owner said limited damage had been caused and that it had since safely transited the strait.

The attack came after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) had warned that attempts to cross the strait along a route designated by the IMO would be "unacceptable and completely dangerous" and vessels should coordinate with Iran.

The Ever Lovely, a Singapore-flagged ship, had been following the UKMTO's recommended route through the strait when it was struck, the ship's owner, Evergreen, said.

"All crew members remain safe as does the vessel itself and all cargo," it added.

The vessel followed a southern route identified by the IMO on Thursday morning, data from the ship-tracking website MarineTraffic reviewed by BBC Verify shows.

IMO chief Dominguez said in a statement on Thursday the ship "did not transit under IMO's evacuation framework", without going into further detail.

Announcing the suspension of the evacuation plan, he said: "I have always reiterated that the safety of the seafarers remains paramount. Therefore, to ensure a coordinated approach and navigational safety, the evacuation plan will be paused until further clarity is obtained."

Hundreds of ships and thousands of sailors have been stranded in the Gulf since February because of the US-Israel war against Iran.

The UN evacuation effort was announced on Tuesday following the reopening of the strait, with Dominguez saying the "large-scale operation" had the cooperation of Iran, Oman, the US, other coastal states in the region and the maritime industry.

The attack came after the body set up by Iran to manage the strait said vessels passing outside designated routes would not be guaranteed safe passage.

In a post on X, the Persian Gulf Strait Authority (PGSA) said: "Any consequences arising from the use of unauthorised routes shall be the responsibility of the vessel's owner, operator and master".

Many ships had been using an alternative route on the southern side of the strait, hugging the coast of Oman, the New York Times reports.

title.en: Flights disrupted in Japan as 2 tropical storms move in
title.zh: 两场热带风暴袭来，日本航班中断

summary.en: Two storms were set to converge above Japan, prompting officials to issue landslide warnings and evacuation orders for hundreds of thousands of people.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 两场风暴预计将在日本上空汇聚，促使官员发布山体滑坡警告，并下令疏散数十万人。 日本取消了 200 多个航班，并暂停了数十趟火车服务，以应对周五从不同方向袭来的两场热带风暴。 风暴“梅卡哈拉”和“希戈斯”分别从西南方向和东部移动，并可能在主群岛上空或附近汇聚。 米卡拉此前被评为台风，但后来被降级为严重热带风暴，周五已经绕过台湾和远离主岛以南的日本冲绳岛。 冲绳西南部的台湾遭遇大雨，冲绳那霸机场的航班受到严重干扰。 尽管降级，周五下午风暴仍然带来高达每小时 144 公里（89 英里）的阵风。 预计梅卡拉将于周六凌晨在九州西南部地区的日本主要岛屿登陆。 热带风暴“希戈斯”穿过日本东南部菲律宾海的路径迄今为止还没有靠近大片陆地。 然而，预计它可能会接近东京以南的日本大陆，当风暴向东穿过日本时，它可能会在那里与梅卡拉会合。 这可能会导致被称为“藤原效应”的大气现象，即两个附近的气旋相互影响，通常是不可预测的，因此很难预测它们的强度和运动。 日本航空和全日空航空总共取消了往返冲绳和鹿儿岛（九州最南端城市）的 120 架航班。 由于担心发生山体滑坡，建议约 100 万人离开家园以防万一。 共同社报道称，由于降雨导致道路封闭，丰田已暂停九州一家工厂的生产，日产也表示计划停止部分生产线。 周五下午，随着风暴向九州移动，日本西部已经报告有大雨。 更东北的京都和大阪的官员表示，河流水位正在上升，并警告可能会发生洪水。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

title.en: Japan needs more foreign workers, but many feel unwelcome
title.zh: 日本需要更多外国工人，但许多人感到不受欢迎

summary.en: While Japan faces a deepening labor shortage and growing demand for foreign workers, it has been moving to tighten visa rules and regulations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
While Japan faces a deepening labor shortage and growing demand for foreign workers, it has been moving to tighten visa rules and regulations.

"I was shocked. It is too much to pay 100,000 yen to extend my visa every three years," said Srijana Sunar, a 29-year-old Nepali woman who has been working at factories in Japan since 2018. She earns 145,000 yen ($900/€790) per month.

In late May, the Japanese government enacted a bill raising the maximum fee for changing residency status or extending a period of stay tenfold from the current 10,000 yen to 100,000 yen by the end of March 2027.

Srijana's husband, Spandan Sunar, who has worked in Japan since 2016 at a transportation company and a Japanese language school, told DW his long-term efforts have "not been rewarded" by Japanese society.

"We are not newcomers. We have proper visa status, we follow the rules and we pay taxes, but our freedom to choose jobs and working conditions is very limited," he said in fluent Japanese.

The young couple, who were married in Japan in 2022, hope to apply for permanent residency — but only if they can afford it.

Under the same bill, the upper limit for permanent residency permit fees would be raised from 10,000 yen to 300,000 yen. This poses another big hurdle for the couple, as an annual individual income of more than 3 million yen has been generally regarded by most applicants as a requirement for permanent residency. 

As of April 2025, Japanese nationals numbered some 119.7 million, down 941,000 from a year earlier, according to the Statistics Bureau of Japan.

Meanwhile, the number of foreign nationals in Japan has been rising at a pace that offsets roughly 40% of that decline. According to the Immigration Services Agency, there were around 4.125 million foreign nationals in the country at the end of 2025, an increase of over 356,000 from the previous year.

" Foreign workers are indispensable . Without them, society would not function," Toshihiro Menju, an expert on Japanese immigration policy, told DW.

"It is impossible to fully make up for labor shortages through women's participation or the use of robots alone," said Menju, who is also a visiting professor at the Kansai University of International Studies.

"The reality is that the number of foreign workers has been increasing across sectors, from highly skilled professions to front-line caregiving fields. The people who support the fundamental infrastructure of society are declining," he added.

title.en: Christmas market attacker jailed for life for murdering six in Germany
title.zh: 德国圣诞市场袭击者谋杀六人被判终身监禁

summary.en: A nine-year-old and five women were killed when Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen drove into the market in 2024.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A court in Germany has sentenced a man to life in prison for an attack on the Christmas market in Magdeburg in 2024, in which six people were killed.

The court imposed the maximum sentence on the defendant, Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen, who is from Saudi Arabia. The 51-year-old was found guilty of murder.

Prosecutors say he drove a rented BMW car at speeds of up to 48km/h (30mph) through the Christmas market in the centre of Magdeburg on 20 December 2024.

They say the attack took place at 19:02 local time when the market was very crowded with Christmas revellers celebrating at the gingerbread and mulled wine stalls. It lasted just a minute and four seconds.

A nine-year-old boy and five women between the ages of 45 and 75 were killed. Around 300 others were injured.

Prosecutors said he planned the attack well in advance and had acted alone. They said he was not pursuing any serious ideological goals, but acted primarily out of personal motives.

"The defendant's sole concern was, and remains, himself," the Chief Public Prosecutor Matthias Böttcher said.

A psychiatric expert said the man had narcissistic personality disorder and an overwhelming need for attention.

Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen told the court he had been motivated to carry out the attack because of conflicts with the German authorities. He said he was angry that the rights of Saudi women were being ignored.

Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen was granted asylum in Germany in 2016. It is understood that he claimed to face the threat of persecution in Saudi Arabia, due to his criticism of Islam and the ruling family. The German Press Agency DPA said he came from Hofuf in Saudi Arabia, and is from the Shiite minority there.

Officials say he had a history of anti-Islamic rhetoric and far-right sympathies.

He has been described as critical of Islam and he also voiced support on social media for the far-right Alternative for Germany party, hailing the party for fighting the same enemy as him "to protect Germany".

Before the attack, he worked at a clinic in Bernburg, as a specialist in psychiatry and psychotherapy. He had been employed since 2020 in a secure psychiatric facility for people with addictions, but had most recently been registered as unfit for work.

A temporary courthouse was erected in Magdeburg for his trial, because of the large number of victims.

Germany's Christmas markets and festivals have come under attack before, mainly from extreme Islamists.

At the time of the attack, officials said Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen was an "untypical" attacker.
body.zh: 德国一家法院判处一名男子终身监禁，罪名是 2024 年马格德堡圣诞市场袭击事件，造成 6 人死亡。 法院对来自沙特阿拉伯的被告塔勒布·阿卜杜勒莫森判处最高刑罚。 51岁的男子被判犯有谋杀罪。 检察官称，2024 年 12 月 20 日，他驾驶一辆租来的宝马汽车，以高达 48 公里/小时（30 英里/小时）的速度穿过马格德堡市中心的圣诞市场。 他们说，袭击发生在当地时间 19 点 02 分，当时市场上挤满了圣诞节狂欢者，他们在姜饼和热红酒摊上庆祝。整个过程只持续了一分零四秒。 一名 9 岁男孩和 5 名年龄在 45 岁至 75 岁之间的妇女被杀。另有约 300 人受伤。 检察官表示，他事先就计划好了这次袭击，并且是单独行动的。他们说，他没有追求任何严肃的意识形态目标，而主要出于个人动机。 首席检察官马蒂亚斯·博彻 (Matthias Böttcher) 表示：“被告唯一关心的是他自己，而且仍然是他自己。” 一位精神病学专家表示，该男子患有自恋型人格障碍，非常需要关注。 塔勒布·阿卜杜勒莫森告诉法庭，他之所以发动这次袭击，是因为与德国当局发生冲突。他说，他对沙特妇女的权利被忽视感到愤怒。 塔勒布·阿卜杜勒穆森 (Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen) 于 2016 年在德国获得庇护。据了解，他声称因批评伊斯兰教和统治家族而在沙特阿拉伯面临迫害威胁。德国新闻社德新社称，他来自沙特阿拉伯的胡富夫，是那里的什叶派少数民族。 官员们表示，他有反伊斯兰言论和同情极右翼的历史。 他被描述为对伊斯兰教的批评者，他还在社交媒体上表达了对极右翼德国另类选择党的支持，称赞该党与他同仇敌忾，“以保护德国”。 袭击发生前，他在贝恩堡的一家诊所工作，担任精神病学和心理治疗专家。自 2020 年以来，他一直在一家为毒瘾患者服务的安全精神病院工作，但最近被登记为不适合工作。 由于受害者人数众多，马格德堡设立了一个临时法院来审判他。 德国的圣诞市场和节日此前曾遭受过攻击，主要来自极端伊斯兰主义者。 袭击发生时，官员们表示塔勒布·阿卜杜勒莫森是一名“非典型”袭击者。

summary.en: Col Dmytro Kozyura agreed to share state secrets and systematically disclosed classified information, prosecutors say.

body.en:
A former high-ranking Ukrainian intelligence official has been sentenced to life in prison for spying for Russia's FSB security service.

Col Dmytro Kozyura was found guilty of high treason under martial law, Ukraine's prosecutor general said. He was previously chief of staff of the Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) anti-terrorism centre.

An operation codenamed "rat" found he had used a safehouse in Kyiv to communicate with Russian handlers seeking classified information about Ukraine's military and leadership, the SBU said.

The prosecutor general said Kozyura had agreed to share information "constituting state secrets" for financial reward and deserved the harshest punishment.

Kyiv has announced numerous operations to expose Russian agents on its soil since Moscow launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022.

After his arrest in February 2025, the SBU released an image of the former official with Ukraine's intelligence chief Vasyl Malyuk , who led the investigation.

In a statement after his sentencing, the agency said he had been recruited by Russia's FSB in Vienna in 2018, but several years had passed before his handlers resumed contact with him in December 2024.

The SBU said he was subsequently asked to gather and share what Ukraine knew about the deployment and movement of Russia's armed forces, and information about Ukraine's weapons, infrastructure and its political and military leadership.

His activities included spying on SBU command posts and "systematically" sharing the consequences of Russian strikes, including the number of wounded soldiers and civilians, a statement from the office of Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko said.

He was in "constant communication" with his handlers, including sharing documents marked "secret", he added.

"The colonel, a career officer in the SBU, had access to state secrets and was responsible for co-ordinating the fight against terrorism," the statement added.

"Anyone who wears Ukrainian epaulets and begins working for the FSB becomes an enemy of Ukraine," Kravchenko said. "Only the harshest punishment is appropriate for such individuals."

Kozyura was arrested last year after SBU officials "monitored every step of the agent around the clock" and found he had communicated with a Russian operative from a safehouse using a separate mobile phone and Wi-Fi router, the SBU said.

It named his FSB handler in Russia as a man called Yuriy Shatalov whose role was to co-ordinate a network of agents.

title.en: Fact check: As Europe bakes, should you trust your sunscreen?
title.zh: 事实核查：随着欧洲的烘烤，您应该相信您的防晒霜吗？

summary.en: As a heatwave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As a heatwave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.

Millions of people across Europe are dealing with  temperatures above 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit), baking under a heat dome, with hot nights making recovery harder.

While many recognize the need to use sunscreen to protect themselves from the sun, some, particularly on social media, have been discussing whether it could actually be harmful.

The discussion centers around the question of whether sunscreen could increase the risk of skin cancer rather than reduce it.

And while the debate is not new, it does seem to be resurfacing more frequently, as global temperatures continue to rise and droughts and extreme heat become the new normal.

Claim: "According to the National Cancer Institute, since the introduction of sunscreen in 1940, melanoma has increased by over 200%."

This claim, archived here, has appeared on several social media platforms. It further describes sunscreen as a "poison" that prevents the body from properly absorbing sunlight.

First, several studies have shown that regularly using sunscreen actually reduces the risk of developing melanoma.

"There is no scientific evidence that supports the association of sunscreen use with a higher risk of cancer," said Brittany Schaefer, Public Information Officer with the Connecticut State Department of Public Health.

Schaefer spoke to DW last year, when the Fact check team debunked similar claims around sunscreen, especially the false assumption that the countries that use the most sunscreen have the highest incidence of skin cancer.

Second, the US National Cancer Institute has not said sunscreen use caused a 200% increase in melanoma since 1940.

According to the data, the rate of newly diagnosed melanoma cases has increased by more than 220% from then to 2023.

However, there is no evidence linking the rise in melanoma cases to sunscreen use.

A 2023 study involving scientists from the US, Germany, Switzerland and Hungary can provide some clues to understand why cases are on the rise.

This final point has also been highlighted by public surveys across several countries, despite recommendations that sunscreen should be used regularly.

In Germany, for example, 51% of respondents said in 2024 that they only use sunscreen in summer or when exposed to direct sunlight, while 17% said they never use it.

And in the United States, a poll conducted in the same year found that 33% of adults admitted to never using sunscreen at all.

body.zh: 随着热浪席卷欧洲，有关防晒霜是否安全或与皮肤癌风险有关的说法在网上重新出现。 欧洲各地数百万人正在忍受 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度）以上的高温，在热穹下烘烤，炎热的夜晚使恢复变得更加困难。 尽管许多人认识到需要使用防晒霜来保护自己免受阳光照射，但一些人，特别是在社交媒体上，一直在讨论防晒霜是否真的有害。 讨论的焦点是防晒霜是否会增加而不是降低皮肤癌的风险。 尽管这场争论并不新鲜，但随着全球气温持续上升、干旱和极端高温成为新常态，它似乎确实越来越频繁地重新出现。 声称：“根据美国国家癌症研究所的数据，自 1940 年推出防晒霜以来，黑色素瘤的发病率增加了 200% 以上。” 此声明已存档于此处，已出现在多个社交媒体平台上。它将防晒霜进一步描述为一种“毒药”，会阻止身体正确吸收阳光。 首先，多项研究表明，定期使用防晒霜实际上可以降低患黑色素瘤的风险。 康涅狄格州公共卫生部公共信息官员布列塔尼·谢弗 (Brittany Schaefer) 表示：“没有科学证据支持使用防晒霜与较高的癌症风险之间存在关联。” 谢弗去年接受德国之声采访时，事实核查小组驳斥了有关防晒霜的类似说法，尤其是“使用防晒霜最多的国家皮肤癌发病率最高”的错误假设。 其次，美国国家癌症研究所并未表示自 1940 年以来使用防晒霜导致黑色素瘤增加 200%。 数据显示，从那时到 2023 年，新诊断的黑色素瘤病例率增加了 220% 以上。 然而，没有证据表明黑色素瘤病例的增加与防晒霜的使用有关。 来自美国、德国、瑞士和匈牙利的科学家于 2023 年进行的一项研究可以提供一些线索，以了解病例为何不断增加。 尽管建议定期使用防晒霜，但多个国家/地区的公共调查也强调了最后一点。 例如，在德国，2024 年有 51% 的受访者表示，他们只在夏季或暴露在阳光直射时使用防晒霜，而 17% 的受访者表示从不使用防晒霜。 在美国，同年进行的一项民意调查发现，33% 的成年人承认从未使用过防晒霜。 美国食品和药物管理局的指南对防晒霜进行监管，以确保其符合安全性和有效性标准，建议...

title.en: The abundant but expensive energy source that's under your feet
title.zh: 脚下蕴藏的丰富但昂贵的能源

summary.en: Start-up companies are exploring new methods to harness geothermal energy, an abundant power source found beneath the earth's surface. The primary challenge for these ventures lies in making the economics of extraction and utilization viable.
summary.zh: 初创公司正在探索利用地热能的新方法，这是一种蕴藏在地表之下、储量丰富的能源。这些企业面临的主要挑战在于如何使地热能的开采和利用在经济上可行。

body.en:
It's hard to get Democrat and Republican politicians to agree on much at the moment, but the benefits of geothermal energy is one rare area of consensus.

Geothermal energy makes use of natural heat below the Earth's surface and the next generation of technology can access hotter, deeper and more varied locations than ever before.

Broadly, the low greenhouse gas emissions of geothermal plants appeals to liberals, while conservatives like the additional energy independence of geothermal, plus the use of drilling technology familiar in the oil and gas industry.

Some US states are trying to accelerate permits for geothermal plants and in April senators from both parties introduced the Next-Generation Geothermal , external Research and Development Act.

The legislation would direct the Department of Energy to support the development and commercialisation of the next generation of geothermal energy systems.

In EGS, underground rock is fractured hydraulically. That's done by pumping pressurised fluid into one well, and then collecting steam or hot water from another well.

Better known as fracking, this technique has become well known and controversial ( particularly in the UK ) in the oil and gas industry.

"It's the same techniques and up to a point it's the same industry as well," sums up Gernot Wagner, a climate economist at Columbia Business School in New York. But "from a climate perspective, there's a huge difference," he adds.

For him, the risk of seismic activity, by creating cracks underground, is outweighed by the benefits of an energy source that is renewable, always-on and large-capacity.

"Based on where we are, moving much faster, much bigger in the direction of using much more geothermal, frankly, is all good news," Wagner says.

Companies are developing drilling equipment that is more stable when breaking through hard rock at high temperatures.

Quaise, a company with roots at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), is using a technology called millimetre wave drilling. The frequency is similar to that of microwaves.

Quaise's application involves "sending electromagnetic waves in the microwave millimetre wave spectrum to essentially melt and vaporise through the rock," explains Harry Kelso, Quaise's communications manager.

Traditional geothermal energy clusters around hotspots on the earth's surface where very hot rocks can be easily accessed.

"Millimetre wave drilling really enables you to access super-hot geothermal just about anywhere in the world," says Kelso.

body.en:
King Charles has revealed that he paid £12.9 million (more than $24.6 million) in tax last year, marking the first time a monarch has publicly disclosed how much personal tax he paid.

That places Charles among the UK's top 100 taxpayers between 2024-2025, local media reported.

The monarch is not liable for tax, but his mother, Queen Elizabeth, began paying it voluntarily in 1993.

Buckingham Palace described the landmark disclosure as part of its "commitment to transparency". Royal finances have long been considered complex, murky and difficult to decipher, and the latest disclosure — which did not include breakdowns of how the figures were calculated — does little to lift the veil.

Royal finances have come under increasing scrutiny in recent years, including following a recent watchdog report into property arrangements involving the king's brother, Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

Palace officials said the amount of tax payable by Charles since he became king in 2022 exceeded £30 million ($57 million).

That includes more than £11.7 million ($22 million) of tax paid from 2023-2024.

The figure for the year following Queen Elizabeth's death in September 2022 was not provided. Tax years in Britain run from early April.

Charles had previously disclosed the amount of tax he paid prior to becoming monarch.

In a similar move, Charles' eldest son, Prince William, also released his personal tax information. The royal report detailed that William paid more than £7.7 million ($14.75 million) in income and capital gain taxes in 2024-2025. The year prior, he paid £8.3 million ($15.9 million), according to his office.

That includes the Sovereign Grant, which provides official public funding for the monarchy and the Privy Purse, which supplies Charles' income through revenue generated by the Duchy of Lancaster estate.

In 2025-2026, funding for the Sovereign Grant increased to £132.1 million (more than $253 million).

Charles receives personal income from land, private estates and investments on top of that figure, which he receives from the government to support royal duties.

Charles' private sources of income include his Balmoral and Sandringham estates as well as art, jewellery, stamp collections, investments and private savings.

body.en:
Australians have been caught up in the devastating earthquakes that hit Venezuela on Thursday.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has confirmed that it is providing consular support "to a small number of Australians that have been affected by the earthquake in Venezuela".

"Owing to our privacy obligations we are unable to provide further comment on individual cases," a spokesperson told SBS News in a statement. They did not confirm in what capacity those citizens have been impacted.

Australian officials are in close contact with local authorities, government, and partners who are attempting to rescue those trapped under the rubble.

Australia does not have an embassy in Venezuela, and the government's ability to provide consular assistance is severely limited.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Friday that his heart "goes out" to anyone with relatives or friends in the country who have been affected by the natural disasters that struck the country's north on Thursday .

"This is one of the worst earthquakes that we've seen in recent times, with catastrophic human consequences, a massive loss of life, but also massive infrastructure damage and real consequences for the people of Venezuela," the prime minister told ABC News Breakfast.

Genesis Lindstrom, president of the Venezuelan Association of Australia, has her community has been desperately seeking information, which is challenging to access given the number of media outlets suspended in the country.

"A lot of the news and updates we're getting are from social media and from people sending through videos and updates," she told News Breakfast.

Lindstrom added that she was in the office when the news broke and started frantically messaging everyone she knows in the country's capital, Caracas.

"Thankfully, as far as I know, most people in my community here have been getting those messages across from family members and loved ones," she said.

Desperate Venezuelans are continuing to dig for people trapped beneath the debris in the worst-hit state of La Guaira, north of Caracas.

The United States Geological Survey measured the earthquakes as magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5, which struck within minutes of each other on Thursday.

Venezuela's health minister Carlos Alvarado said the death toll had risen to 235. At least 1,520 are thought to be injured.

The United Nation's Central Emergency Response Fund has released $22 million to support response efforts in Venezuela.

United Nations-certified rescuers will help search for survivors, interim Venezuelan president Delcy Rodriguez said in a televised message.

body.en:
It's been a big day for football fans in Australia, with the Socceroos' make-or-break match against Paraguay ending nil-all — securing Australia's spot in the Round of 32.

The 0-0 result was enough for the Socceroos to finish second in Group D, allowing them to advance to the knockouts for the third time in history. There, they'll face the second-placed Group G team — whoever they turn out to be — on 4 July at 4am AEST.

The Socceroos, who defeated Türkiye in their opening match before losing to the United States, were never seriously threatened on their way to securing a point to reach the last 32.

title.en: The 'yellow line' Gazans have been killed for crossing, according to new report
title.zh: 新报告称，加沙人因越过“黄线”而被杀害

summary.en: A new report indicates that children in Gaza continue to be targeted even after a ceasefire, a finding that Israel has rejected.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，即使在停火之后，加沙的儿童仍被当作目标，以色列对此调查结果表示拒绝。

body.en:
Eight months after the Gaza ceasefire began , Palestinian children are still being targeted by Israeli forces for crossing the vaguely defined "yellow line", according to a new report from the United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry.

The commission alleges Israeli forces have continued to deliberately target Palestinian children during the ceasefire, which, alongside the targeting of healthcare and education facilities and restricting the flow of aid, it says is severely impacting the ability of children to thrive.

"Even if the bombs and guns fall silent in Gaza and the West Bank, Palestinian children will not simply recover overnight," the commission's chair, Srinivasan Muralidhar, said in a statement.

The United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry, which does not speak on behalf of the UN as a whole and has been sharply criticised by Israel, concluded in September that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

Israel is separately defending a genocide case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), which has ordered provisional measures but has yet to issue a final ruling.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A spokesperson for Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs rejected the recent report's findings, calling it a "propaganda piece as outrageous as its previous ones".

"It completely erases Israeli children who were brutally murdered, kidnapped, and targeted by Hamas, while ignoring Hamas' cynical use of Palestinian children as human shields and pawns of war," it said.

Since the ceasefire began in October, the Ministry of Health in Gaza reported that at least 978 Palestinians had been killed, and just under 4,000 injured — a statistic that cannot be independently verified as Israel does not permit international journalists to enter Gaza.

The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) estimated 265 of post-ceasefire deaths were children.

Israel and Hamas have repeatedly accused each other of violating the truce since it came into effect.

Australian emergency doctor Thienminh Dinh, 37, managed medical activities at the Doctors Without Borders field hospital in Al-Zawaida, Gaza, for two stints.

The first, between May and June 2025, was before the ceasefire. The second stint, between October and December 2025, began shortly after the ceasefire was announced.

She told SBS News there was a slight decrease in the volume of air strikes after the ceasefire, but the attacks still continued.

"There were still daily blasts. We also saw critical medical supplies, humanitarian and infant formula repeatedly delayed or obstructed from reaching our team."

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...

Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Southeast Asia boost defense ties but avoids firm alliances
title.zh: 东南亚加强防务关系但避免建立牢固联盟

summary.en: Countries across the region are expanding defense cooperation in ways that change the South China Sea equation but fall short of a new anti-China bloc.
summary.zh: 东南亚各国正在扩大防务合作，这改变了南海局势，但尚未形成新的反华联盟。

body.en:
Countries across the region are expanding defense cooperation in ways that change the South China Sea equation but fall short of a new anti-China bloc.

For years, the South China Sea has been seen as a potential flashpoint in the intensifying geopolitical rivalry between China and the United States.   

Southeast Asian states are often presented as the smaller powers caught in the storm.

That picture is changing, however, as a new and subtle security network takes shape across the region.

It's built not around formal alliances but around access deals, missile sales, coast guard drills, intelligence-sharing talks and defense consultations.

On June 1, the Philippines and Vietnam upgraded ties to an enhanced strategic partnership and signed a memorandum on defense cooperation which commits them to high-level exchanges, strategic dialogue, information sharing and joint activities at sea.

The partnership builds on earlier coast guard arrangements, including a hotline and mechanisms to prevent incidents.

Late last month, Indian officials said that New Delhi had signed a $629 million (€555 million) deal to supply Vietnam with the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile system.

Vietnam is the second Southeast Asian buyer publicly confirmed by India, after the Philippines, which signed a $375 million contract in 2022 for three BrahMos batteries. The missiles are jointly developed by India and Russia.

Meanwhile, Japan's security relationship with the Philippines has grown quite concrete.   A Reciprocal Access Agreement entered into force last September , expanding troop deployment in each country, while this month they began talks over a new deal to share classified defense information.

In February, Australia and Indonesia signed the "Jakarta Treaty," a common security pact that commits the two governments to regular top-level consultations.

None of these agreements creates a NATO-style alliance . Together, however, they show how middle powers are trying to make unilateral pressure at sea harder and costlier.

All these countries share concerns about China and an interest in upholding the rule of law at sea and keeping the region free from coercion by great powers, Hunter Marston, director of the Southeast Asia Program at the Lowy Institute, told DW.

At the same time, they recognize — to varying degrees — the possibility that the US could scale back its commitments to regional security, which would introduce volatility and unpredictability into the prevailing balance of power, he said.

"While they don't all see eye to eye on regional security or support the United States military presence equally, now is the time for middle powers to band together to stand up for their interests. None are strong enough to do so...
body.zh: 该地区各国正在扩大防务合作，其方式改变了南海局势，但并未形成新的反华集团。 多年来，南海一直被视为中美地缘政治竞争的潜在爆发点。 东南亚国家经常被描述为陷入风暴的小国。 然而，随着整个地区新的、微妙的安全网络的形成，这种情况正在发生变化。 它不是围绕正式联盟建立的，而是围绕准入协议、导弹销售、海岸警卫队演习、情报共享会谈和国防磋商建立的。 6 月 1 日，菲律宾和越南将关系提升为强化战略伙伴关系，并签署了一份防务合作备忘录，承诺两国进行高层交往、战略对话、信息共享和海上联合活动。 该伙伴关系建立在早期海岸警卫队安排的基础上，包括热线电话和预防事件的机制。 上个月末，印度官员表示，新德里已签署一项价值 6.29 亿美元（5.55 亿欧元）的协议，向越南提供布拉莫斯超音速巡航导弹系统。 越南是继菲律宾之后印度公开确认的第二个东南亚买家，菲律宾于2022年签署了价值3.75亿美元的三块布拉莫斯电池合同。该导弹由印度和俄罗斯联合研制。 与此同时，日本与菲律宾的安全关系变得相当具体。 去年九月，一项互惠访问协议生效，扩大了两国的部队部署，本月他们开始就一项共享机密国防信息的新协议进行谈判。 今年二月，澳大利亚和印度尼西亚签署了《雅加达条约》，这是一项共同安全条约，要求两国政府定期进行高层磋商。 这些协议都没有创建北约式的联盟。然而，它们共同表明中等强国如何试图加大海上单边施压的难度和成本。 洛伊研究所东南亚项目主任亨特·马斯顿告诉德国之声，所有这些国家都对中国感到担忧，都对维护海上法治和使该地区免受大国胁迫感兴趣。 他表示，与此同时，他们在不同程度上认识到美国可能缩减其对地区安全的承诺，这将给当前的均势带来波动和不可预测性。 “虽然他们在地区安全问题上意见不一，也并不平等地支持美国的军事存在，但现在是中等强国联合起来维护自身利益的时候了。没有一个国家足够强大，可以这样做……

reflection.en: The nations of Southeast Asia are navigating complex geopolitical waters, seeking security through cooperation while carefully avoiding actions that could escalate tensions. This delicate balance reflects a desire to live at peace, as far as it depends on them, even amidst strategic disagreements. Yahweh calls us to pursue peace with all people, a principle...
reflection.zh: 东南亚各国在复杂的国际局势中寻求平衡，通过防务合作增强安全，同时谨慎避免可能加剧紧张局势的行动。这种微妙的平衡反映了他们尽力与各方和平相处的愿望，即使存在战略分歧。雅伟呼召我们尽力与所有人和睦相处，这一原则指导着人际关系和国际外交。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

body.en: China’s LineShine debuts at number one in Top500 – a list sometimes viewed as a national measure of global tech prowess A supercomputer in China now outranks its US counterparts as the world’s most powerful. It is the first time since 2017 that a Chinese computer has topped a list sometimes viewed as a measure of a nation’s technological prowess. The LineShine computer in Shenzhen displaced top-ranked US computer El Capitan in the Top500 rankings released on Tuesday. It was LineShine’s debut on the list. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国的 LineShine 首次跻身 Top500 排行榜第一名——该榜单有时被视为衡量全球科技实力的国家标准。中国的超级计算机现已超过美国同行，成为世界上最强大的计算机。这是自 2017 年以来中国计算机首次跻身有时被视为衡量一个国家技术实力的榜单榜首。在周二发布的 Top500 排名中，深圳的 LineShine 计算机取代了排名第一的美国计算机 El Capitan。这是 LineShine 首次上榜。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

title.en: 'Beautiful stuff': Socceroos react as Australians pack out watch parties
title.zh: “太棒了”：澳大利亚足球队在观赛派对上座无虚席，球员们反响热烈

summary.en: Australia was captivated by "Socceroos fever" as the national football team played Paraguay in California, with many Australians gathering at watch parties to support them.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚全国上下都沉浸在“足球热”中，因为国家足球队在加利福尼亚对阵巴拉圭，许多澳大利亚人聚集在观赛派对上为他们加油。

body.en:
Fans decked out in green and gold turned out across the country to support the Socceroos as they drew with Paraguay to secure a spot in the World Cup knockout rounds.

And the Socceroos said they felt the love, when shown footage by SBS reporters of children at an Australian primary school erupting at the end of the match.

"It gives you a bit of self satisfaction that we have put a smile on all these people's faces and our journey isn't over yet so hopefully we can continue our journey for as long as possible."

Rowdy crowds packed Melbourne's Federation Square, pushing it to maximum capacity by 10am. Multiple flares were let off and a small brawl broke out but the atmosphere was mostly positive, if charged.

Roughly 7,500 people packed into the live site to watch the match, which resulted in a 0-0 draw — but was sufficient to send Australia through to the knockout round of the tournament.

While the fan base was a mixture of ages, teenagers who should have been at school for the last day of term filled Fed Square, some wearing the Australian flag as a cape.

Chants of "Aussie, Aussie, Aussie" could be heard through the crowd while beach balls were bounced over the audience.

Ducking responsibilities to support the national team was a bit of a theme on Friday, given the 12pm AEST kick- off.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he expected employers would be understanding if staff failed to return to work after lunch if the Socceroos won, while Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said bosses should act "with thoughts of our national interest".

Two unnamed fans told SBS News at Fed Square during the match: "It's un-Australian not to take the sick leave to get it off."

At Sydney's main viewing site, Tumbalong Park, similar numbers were seen, with many fans also on the younger side.

"I’m missing school. It's the last day of term for us, but you gotta support the Socceroos," a fan told SBS News.

While most fans were well behaved, three teenagers in Melbourne were issued penalty notices for riotous behaviour and given move-on notices. In Sydney, a 16-year-old was arrested at Tumbalong Park.

Australia managed to secure a convincing entry to the round of 32 with their clean sheet draw with Paraguay. They will face off against the second-placed team from Group G on 4 July.

Both major party leaders congratulated the team, with Opposition leader Angus Taylor referencing his famous digital blunder to congratulate the Socceroos. In 2019, he replied to his own Facebook post about extra car parking spaces at NSW railway stations with the comment: Fantastic. Great move. Well done Angus.

title.en: Melbourne beach temporarily renamed after Patrick Beach as Socceroos reach Round of 32
title.zh: 墨尔本海滩因足球队门将帕特里克·比奇表现出色而暂时更名

summary.en: Socceroos goalkeeper Patrick Beach's performance in the team's match against Paraguay has earned him a tribute back in Melbourne, with a local beach temporarily renamed in his honor.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚足球队门将帕特里克·比奇在对阵巴拉圭的比赛中表现出色，墨尔本的一处海滩因此暂时以他的名字命名，以示敬意。

body.en:
The City of Port Philip in Melbourne's south says the iconic beachfront will be renamed after Melbourne City and Socceroos goalkeeper Patrick Beach for the remainder of the national squad's FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign.

It comes after the team's 0-0 draw against Paraguay secured their spot in the knockout rounds of this year's tournament.

At 22 years old, the goalkeeper made a surprise World Cup debut for the Socceroos against Türkiye and has remained in goal for all of the side's 2026 World Cup games.

He saved two shots on target in the Socceroos' clash against Paraguay and is one of seven players on the squad with Melbourne City connections.

Melbourne City FC CEO Brad Rowse said his side was "incredibly proud" of the young player.

"You spend years developing players and hope they make a World Cup squad," Rowse said.

"Having a beach renamed after one of them wasn't something we'd planned for, but we're happy to take it."

The council's town hall will also be illuminated in green and gold on Friday night, following the team's third-ever entry into the knockout round.

City of Port Phillip mayor Alex Makin said his council wanted to celebrate the Socceroos' win and the strong connection between Melbourne and the national squad.

"This is about getting behind the Socceroos and sharing in the excitement of the World Cup at home," he said in a statement.

"Renaming St Kilda Beach is a uniquely local way to celebrate the team and embrace the global energy right here in Port Phillip.”

The City of Port Philip said plans for a mural dedicated to the young player were "underway".

Having made it through to the Round of 32, Australia will next face the second-placed Group G team on 4 July in Arlington, Texas.

body.en:
Karl Stefanovic will leave Nine after nearly two decades on the Today show, following a podcast interview with far-right British figure Tommy Robinson.

Nine chief executive Matt Stanton informed staff in an email on Friday that it was the "right time" for Stefanovic to move on, the Sydney Morning Herald — owned by Nine — reported.

"Karl has been a fixture on our screens for over two decades, so we know this is a significant change for our viewers and all of us here at Nine, however it’s the right time to make it," Stanton said in the email.

In a statement to SBS News, Nine said Stefanovic was already set to leave the network at the end of the year.

"Nine Entertainment and Karl Stefanovic have agreed that it is no longer possible for him to continue hosting Today at the same time as his independent podcast," a spokesperson told SBS News.

"While Karl and Nine had previously agreed he would leave Today at the end of this year, they have subsequently decided he will leave the Network immediately."

Executives finalised the terms of his exit on Friday morning, ending his run as Australia's highest-paid television presenter.

It remains unclear whether Nine will pay out the estimated $1 million balance of his contract.

On Friday morning, Stefanovic released a statement via a YouTube video, saying he was "free".

"I’m free. Truly independent. I didn’t get the chance to thank my free-to-air audience for 21 years, so thank you for riding the ups and downs," he said.

"It wasn’t easy, this last couple of days, but we rolled on. So here’s what I believe in: the public deserve to hear perspectives."

"On my show, I’ve spoken to people who have different perspectives — I know that winds some people up.

"Sometimes I agree with everything a guest says, sometimes I don’t. But importantly, you get to make up your mind."

"Freedom of speech — here and around the world — is what this show is about. You don’t have to listen to my show — you have the power."

"It’s a matter, of course, for Channel Nine, but words do matter, and what people who are very prominent in our public discourse do, and how they conduct themselves, matters as well," Albanese told ABC.

summary.en: With the Socceroos one match away from the World Cup knockout rounds, employers are being urged to embrace football fever.
